name: Whale Shark
read: Correctly oriented and cleanly lit, with a real eye and strong countershade, but the species is wrong. A whale shark is a broad, flat-headed filter feeder; this is the great white silhouette with a pointed snout and a toothy predator jaw. The faint spots do not recover the species.

name: Dunkleosteus
read: Correctly oriented and cleanly lit, with a real eye and strong countershade, but the species is wrong. Dunkleosteus is an armoured placoderm with a bony head plate and no true teeth; this renders as an ordinary great white.

name: Greenland Shark
read: Correctly oriented and cleanly lit, with a real eye and strong countershade, but the species is wrong. A Greenland shark is a blunt, stubby, slow-bodied deep-water shark; this is the standard great white profile.
